# NeuralNg Overlay

Import from `@neural-ng/core/overlay`.

- This is low-level infrastructure for floating NeuralNg components.
- Prefer `neuralTooltip` for plain descriptive tooltips.
- Placements: top, top-start, top-end, bottom, bottom-start, bottom-end, left,
  right.
- Always call `destroy()` on the returned position reference.
- Positioning uses CSS Anchor Positioning when supported and a dependency-free
  viewport-aware JavaScript fallback elsewhere.
